scope: Episodic recall: extract_sit_fp() IMMUTABLE fingerprint extractor, recall_situation() situational recall function, ix_pgmnemo_sit_fp_active expression index on agent_lesson, remember_event() writes sit_fp into metadata JSONB at record time. RECLASSIFICATION CONTRACT comments added to all three typed write verbs (remember_fact/event/relation) documenting the protection asymmetry introduced by reclassify_corpus() in v0.14.2. No ranking algorithm change, no confidence/reinforce change, no GUC additions, no table/column/index schema change (index is expression-only).
justification: Functional gate — NO recall-quality claim is made by this release, so no statistical validation is required. Two additions: (1) extract_sit_fp() + recall_situation() are pure lookup paths that do not touch the scoring stack (recall_hybrid, recall_fast, RRF weights, recency, confidence); the new ix_pgmnemo_sit_fp_active index is expression-only over an IMMUTABLE function and does not alter query plans for existing recall functions. (2) RECLASSIFICATION CONTRACT comments are SQL COMMENT ON FUNCTION strings — metadata only, zero runtime effect. All 16 episodic pg_regress tests pass (A1-1 through A2-6), confirming fingerprint correctness across 11 wording variants and correct exclusion of a different incident class. Both suites green: 52/52 extension suite, 8/8 root suite.
schema_change_detail: No table, column, or GUC change. One new expression index (ix_pgmnemo_sit_fp_active) on existing table agent_lesson. Two new functions (extract_sit_fp, recall_situation), one replaced function body (remember_event with sit_fp metadata write). COMMENT ON FUNCTION updates on remember_fact, remember_event, remember_relation.
scoring_impact: none — recall ranking, confidence, and reinforce() paths are untouched; no changes to recall_hybrid(), recall_fast(), or any scoring coefficient
recall_ranking_impact: none — no change to result ordering, RRF weights, graph-proximity boost, recency stamping, or any GUC
backward_compat_proof: recall_situation() is a new function; no callers of existing functions are broken. remember_event() gains a new 'sit_fp' key in metadata JSONB (additive, backward-compatible). extract_sit_fp() is a new IMMUTABLE function. All 51 pre-existing extension/ tests continue to pass. Upgrade path: 0.14.2→0.15.0 (single upgrade script). Fresh-install path: pgmnemo--0.15.0.sql. No API surface changes to existing functions.

corpus.note: functional gate only; no recall-quality claim is made by this release and therefore no statistical validation is required
